neighbours.label: a noun for equipment or technology used as the modifier of a following head noun (hardware maker, device manufacturer, software publisher)
fire: Dell, the computer hardware company, cut hundreds of jobs.
He took a job at a large software firm in Seattle.
The medical device industry faces new safety rules.
A local equipment rental shop lent us the ladder.
The network hardware supplier missed its delivery date.
Our lab bought a new imaging device platform last year.
The game software developer released a patch on Monday.
Several machinery dealers showed tractors at the fair.

notes: Probes: hardware maker 0.25, device manufacturer 0.31, software company 0.19, equipment dealer 0.19; non-tech modifiers (farm owners, car agency) under 0.07. Weak overall.
